title: Plugin and document processing pipeline
spec: Build an npm-only local document-processing plugin with a Python extraction pipeline and a Node TypeScript adapter. Generate 200 deterministic mixed Markdown, CSV, SVG, and small PDF-like fixtures, extract metadata incrementally, create a search index, and expose tool-style JSON interfaces. Include malformed-file isolation and tests in both languages. Root package scripts must include test:node and build; test:node must run the complete TypeScript test suite. Provide an executable scripts/test-python.sh that activates the project-local import path and runs the complete Python suite with the project's chosen test runner. Keep an npm package-lock.json beside either the root or nested Node package; do not create pnpm, Yarn, or Bun lockfiles. Do not call remote services.
prompts: Create the Python and TypeScript packages, shared JSON schema, fixture generator, and focused contract tests. Create one project-local .venv, install declared Python dependencies into it once, and install declared Node dependencies once.
Generate 200 mixed fixtures and implement bounded-memory incremental extraction with deterministic metadata output.
Implement the tool-style TypeScript adapter, search index, pagination, and cross-language contract tests.
Add malformed-file isolation, cancellation, retry limits, and regression fixtures for large and invalid documents.
Run both test suites, fixture regeneration checks, indexing benchmark, and package builds. Fix failures and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
